articleTitle: Disney Appoints First‑Ever CTO as It Pushes Technology into Every Wing

sources.title: Disney names Karandeep Anand as first-ever CTO as media giant expands tech push
Disney names CTO for the first time as media giant expands tech push

claims.claim: Walt Disney Co. announced that Karandeep Anand will become the company’s first chief technology officer, a position that did not exist in Disney’s C‑suite before.
claims.bestSource: Disney names Karandeep Anand as first-ever CTO as media giant expands tech push

claims.bestPassage: Walt Disney Co. has named Karandeep Anand to the newly created role of chief technology officer, marking the first time the entertainment giant will have a corporate-wide technology chief.

claims.claim: Anand will report directly to CEO Josh D’Amaro and will oversee enterprise technology, infrastructure, data and artificial intelligence platforms, as well as product and engineering across the company.
claims.bestSource: Disney names CTO for the first time as media giant expands tech push
claims.evidence: Disney said Anand will oversee enterprise technology, infrastructure, data and artificial intelligence platforms, product and engineering at Disney, and will work across across various tech teams to "further modernize how Disney builds and delivers technology company-wide." "Karandeep brings a rare mix of experience across infrastructure, consumer technology and AI, and will be a vital addition to Disney's senior leadership team as we further our three priorities: great storytelling as our North Star, technology in service of creativity, and operating as One Disney," D'Amaro said in Friday's release. The newly created position in the Mouse House's C-suite will report directly to CEO Josh D'Amaro .

claims.bestSource: Disney names Karandeep Anand as first-ever CTO as media giant expands tech push

Anand previously served as chief executive officer of Character.AI, an online chatbot platform that allows users to interact with artificially created characters. Before joining Character.AI, Anand worked at Microsoft Corp. and Facebook, where he served as vice president for ads and business products. He also held several leadership roles at Meta’s Facebook, most recently as vice president of Ads & Business Products.
